evidence.excerpt: Returns. Last holiday season. Buy online, return in store.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Tom
evidence.note: Trigger of the evaluation: omnichannel returns problem during the holidays.

evidence.excerpt: The store couldn't see the online order, so staff were refunding to gift cards or telling people to mail it back.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Tom
evidence.note: Concrete failure behind the trigger; stores lacked order visibility.

contradictions.what: Tom first named CTO Raj as final decider, then revealed Angela (COO) signed with Adyen and conceded 'Probably Angela'.
Tom says they were ahead right before the workshop, yet he also says he knew it was lost during the workshop; the lead rests on Raj's word and the web side only.
Tom calls Raj his contact all the way and the decider, but the actual signer, Angela, was met only once at the kickoff.
Tom says 'we were ahead' while the customer's questions had shifted to stores (11 of 14) and the unified commerce pitch got silence.

dodges.what: Hedged with 'Probably' and 'I think' after the earlier flat claim of Raj.
